emulators.title: PS5SX2 — PS2 Emulator Installer
emulators.description: A native PS2 emulator for jailbroken PS5 consoles, based on PCSX2 with Vulkan graphics. This installer downloads the app from GitHub; later updates can be started inside PS5SX2.
emulators.author: Swordpdf / PCSX2 contributors
emulators.compatibilityNote: Upstream reports testing through 13.60. USB keyboard/mouse support has limitations on 11.x and 12.00; this does not describe controller compatibility.
requirements: Jailbroken PS5 with kstuff and ShadowMountPlus.
Load the PS5SX2 helper appropriate to your ShadowMountPlus version.
Internet access for the installer download.
emulators.bios: Use your own dumped PS2 BIOS in /data/PCSX2/bios. The bundled OpenPS2BIOS is experimental.
emulators.games: Place your game backups in /data/PCSX2/games (.iso, .chd, .cso or .zso).
emulators.controls: D-pad/stick: browse; Cross/OPTIONS: play; Square: settings. Hold L2 + D-pad Down for one second for the in-game menu.
emulators.uninstall: No uninstall procedure is specified in the linked release. Consult upstream and back up personal emulator data before removal.
emulators.instructions: Load the required helper and kstuff/ShadowMountPlus, then send this installer. The helper is not included in this Manager entry. The installer can fetch a newer app build than the release linked here.
emulators.name: PS5SX2Installer.elf
